author: reek
body: Authenticated removal, proven. Two files are stored, both signed by the owner. The owner then retires a.codex with a signed tombstone, and a forger -- a key the manifest does not hold -- tries to retire b.codex the same way. The AUTHENTICATED index honors the owner's removal and refuses the forger's, so a.codex is gone and b.codex stays. The TRUSTING index, which reads a removal by its path and asks no questions, drops both -- the behavior the tree has always had, and the reason an unsigned tombstone was a hole.
